verdict.rationale: Twenty's own no-code workflow engine includes a "Send email" action that can be chained with Delay, Branches and Iterator steps, so ops users can send email from inside the CRM and assemble a rough multi-step cadence. There is no documented email templating, prospect-sequence feature, or enrollment and reply-stop logic; the email-sync evidence covers only importing and linking mailbox messages. Missing for 10: documented email templates with merge fields, a native sequence/cadence builder with enrollment and stop-on-reply, send-from-record UI, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can send templated emails or multi-step sequences to prospects from inside the CRM

citations.quote: Workflows can chain any combination of: Record operations... Send email... HTTP request... Code... Branches... Iterator... AI Agent... Delay... Form
Workflows let you automate repetitive tasks and connect Twenty to external tools — without writing code (though you can if you want to).
Trigger workflows on record changes, schedules, manual actions, or incoming webhooks.
